footnote_text: Pursuant to a Debt Conversion Agreement, dated November 6, 2026 (the "Conversion Agreement"), between Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd (the "Issuer") and the Reporting Person, the Issuer agreed to convert US$3,000,000 of outstanding indebtedness owed to the Reporting Person under the demand grid promissory note, date October 31, 2026, into 4,615,384 Class B ordinary shares of the Issuer (the "Class B Ordinary Shares"), at a conversion price of US$0.65 per share. The Class B Ordinary Shares were issued to the Reporting Person in satisfaction and discharge of such indebtedness. || Includes 383,651 Class B Ordinary Shares held in street name through a brokerage account for the benefit of the Reporting Person.
